decisions.reason: As a newly launched service built directly on the firm's existing contact-centre and cloud capabilities, it is still an inexpensive strategic option to keep open and there is no clear evidence yet that its value has failed to materialise.

Because this routing platform is very close to the established offer, appears actively promoted with its own page, and likely uses existing network and service infrastructure, management would be inclined to keep it on the market while demand uncertainty continues to resolve.
